name: knowledge-rag
description: Local RAG system for Claude Code with hybrid search (inverted-index BM25 + semantic vectors), cross-encoder reranking, snippet mode, and 13 MCP tools. Parses 33 file formats by default, 35 with the opt-in MetaTrader ones. Zero external servers.
author: Lyon.
features: Hybrid search (inverted-index BM25 + semantic vectors + RRF fusion)
Snippet mode (truncate to ~500 chars, saves ~72% tokens)
Raw cross-encoder reranker_score on each result, comparable across queries
SSE/HTTP transport (1 server serves N clients)

33 file formats by default (MD, TXT, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, IPYNB, JSON, XML, CSV, PY, C, H, CPP, JS, JSX, TS, TSX, GO, RS, KT, YAML, YML, HUJSON, CUE, PROTO, REGO, SQL, SH, JQ, Dockerfile, Makefile, Tiltfile), plus opt-in MQ4 and MQH
13 MCP tools (search, CRUD, URL ingestion, similarity, evaluation, reindex progress)
Usage skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other assistants, installed with `knowledge-rag skills install`
Optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration (CUDA via ONNX)
Zero external servers (ONNX in-process via FastEmbed)
